# stream

```go
import "github.com/kitsunium/sdk/framework/app/stream"
```

Package stream plugs kit's streams in: the log a streamed topic (a topic made Streamed) appends each message to once, whatever its number of subscriptions, and the consumer groups its subscriptions read it as — the SDK's stream in memory, in the data directory or on a database. A product that declares a streamed topic imports it:

```
import _ "github.com/kitsunium/sdk/framework/app/stream"
```

A product that declares none does not, and links none of the SDK's stream; a program that declares one without it is refused at the start, the refusal naming this import (CodeSubsystemMissing). It imports framework/app/store: a stream on a database joins the store subsystem's transactions. framework/app does not import it: kit gen writes the line for a designed product, and a hand-written one writes it.
